summary: Without bash 4.2, register each Ansible CLI with eval $(register-python-argcomplete <tool>) in your shell profile.
questions: How do I set up Ansible completion on older bash?
Where should I put register-python-argcomplete commands?

answer_card.title: Per-command argcomplete setup
answer_card.answer_md:
Add to `~/.profile` or `~/.bash_profile`:
```console
eval $(register-python-argcomplete ansible)
eval $(register-python-argcomplete ansible-playbook)
eval $(register-python-argcomplete ansible-galaxy)
eval $(register-python-argcomplete ansible-vault)
# ...and ansible-config, -console, -doc, -inventory, -pull
```
